title: Eagles More Ores!
description: a simple mod that adds more ores!
body:
A simple mod that adds 5 new Ores, each having blocks and unique properties.

1. **Tin** 

 Tin ore adds a new armor set between Chainmail and Iron, has many blocks, which when hit by

rain makes a tin roof sound, a Pressure Plate that only tracks when a player is standing on 

it, can be combined with raw copper to make Bronze, can be used to trim armor.

2. **Bronze**

 Bronze ore adds a new armor set between Iron and Diamond, having mostly the same blocks as 
 
Tin, and a Pressure Plate that only tracks when a player is standing on it, can be used to 

trim armor.

3. **Silver**

 Silver ore adds a new armor set between Leather and Chainmail, having the ability to be used 

in a multi way repeater, can be used to trim armor.

4. **Monnite**

 Monnite ore is most commonly found in Cherry Groves, adds a new set equal to diamond, but 

much faster attack speed than diamond, can be used to make a Monnite cake, which gives Speed 2

and Haste 2 for 3 minutes, can be used to trim armor.

5. **Enderite**

 Enderite is very rarely found above the void in the end isles, having the ability to walk on

the void, and allows more knockback to make running away easier, and can craft a Ender Anchor,

with it you can link a Ender Remote, which when link you can right click to teleport back to 

the Anchor, can be used to trim armor and for a Beacon.

Also adds some more blocks to Iron and Gold.
